atoms.b: Horse chestnuts use ((++gravity wind)) to disperse their seeds.
Oak trees also use gravity to disperse their seeds, which are called ((++acorns almonds)).

Seeds that are dispersed by gravity are ((light ++heavy)) and will eventually drop from the tree. When they drop from the tree, they roll away, the shell ((++opens stays_closed)), and a new ((++plant leaf)) will grow.

instruction.text: Select the plant that disperses its seeds via gravity.

trainers.hint: Which plant has a ready-made heavy seed?

instruction.text: Put the stages of seed dispersal into the correct order, with the first step at the top. You can select each image to hear a description.
